name: United States
note: Hybrid is an accepted interim step; the end state is pure PQC.
applies_to: Specified US federal-agency systems. National security systems are excluded from EO 14412 and are governed separately by NSA CNSA 2.0. Private-sector organisations are not bound by either.

name: Canada
note: CCCS roadmap ITSM.40.001 allows hybrid as a transitional stage; high-priority systems by 2031, full migration to pure PQC by 2035.
applies_to: Government of Canada systems, via the CCCS migration roadmap.

name: European Union
note: ENISA recommends PQ/T hybrid schemes through the transition; NIS Cooperation Group roadmap targets high-risk systems by 2030 and full PQC by 2035.
applies_to: EU-level coordinated implementation roadmap addressed to member states; member states implement nationally.

name: United Kingdom
note: Hybrid is acceptable as an interim; NCSC prefers a pure-PQC end state.
applies_to: Staged migration targets published as NCSC guidance for UK organisations; not a single binding cut-off date.

name: France
note: Hybrid is required through the transition; ANSSI accepts hybrid as a long-term posture, not only an interim step.
applies_to: ANSSI position paper and security-visa qualification requirements; applies to products seeking French qualification.

name: Germany
note: Hybrid (classical + PQC) is required through the transition; BSI accepts hybrid as a long-term posture, not only an interim step.
applies_to: BSI TR-02102 technical guideline; binding for German federal systems, advisory elsewhere.

name: Japan

name: South Korea
note: National PQC master plan targets full transition by 2035; hybrid is an interim step.

name: Australia
note: ASD does not mandate hybrid and permits adopting final PQC standards directly; recommends a pure end state.
applies_to: Australian government systems under the ASD Information Security Manual.

name: Singapore
note: CSA Quantum-Safe Handbook treats hybrid as an optional transitional choice toward a pure end state.
applies_to: Financial institutions regulated by MAS, via the MAS quantum-security advisory/circular.

name: India
note: DST/NQM National Quantum Mission roadmap (2023) and CERT-In guidelines mandate PQC adoption for Critical Information Infrastructure by 2027 and full nationwide adoption by 2033. Published guidance aligns with NIST standards toward pure PQC; no explicit hybrid requirement published.
applies_to: Critical Information Infrastructure operators, via the DST/National Quantum Mission quantum-safe roadmap; CERT-In BOM guidelines cover CBOM/QBOM reporting. A national roadmap with dated milestones rather than a binding cut-off for all organisations.
